## Load data
```{r load_data, echo=FALSE}

# All conditions

df_times <- read_csv(here("preprocessed data", "df_times.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
# df_times <- read_csv("../preprocessed data/df_times.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
	select(- '...1') %>%
	mutate(Effector = if_else(Effector == "D", "Finger", "Hand"),
			Feedback = if_else(Participant <= 26, "WithFbk", "NoFbk")) %>%
	rename(ISI = Period,
		   IPI = Peak_interval,
		   Asynchrony = Asyns_c)
df_times$ISI <- factor(df_times$ISI, levels=c('444','666'), ordered=TRUE)
df_times$Effector <- factor(df_times$Effector, levels=c('Finger','Hand'), ordered=TRUE)

df_voltages <- read_csv(here("preprocessed data", "df_voltages.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
# df_voltages <- read_csv("../preprocessed data/df_voltages.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
	select(- '...1') %>%
	mutate(Effector = if_else(Effector == "D", "Finger", "Hand")) %>%
	rename(ISI = Period,
			Voltage = Voltages)
df_voltages$ISI <- factor(df_voltages$ISI, levels=c('444','666'), ordered=TRUE)
df_voltages$Effector <- factor(df_voltages$Effector, levels=c('Finger','Hand'), ordered=TRUE)
```

## Out-of-phase data (subjects not following instructions)
```{r remove_out_of_phase, echo=FALSE}
# Detect and remove out-of-phase data

ISI_fraction_max = 0.25
outphase_fraction_max = 0.25


# condition for out-of=phase taps: large asynchrony close to half period
# (relative to mean asynchrony)
outphase_condition <- "Asynchrony + m_asyn > ISI_fraction_max*as.numeric(as.character(ISI)) | Asynchrony + m_asyn < -ISI_fraction_max*as.numeric(as.character(ISI))"

# plot out-of-phase subjects
plot_outphase <- df_times %>%
	group_by(Participant, Cond, Trial) %>%
	mutate(nTaps = n(),
		m_asyn = mean(Asynchrony)) %>%
	filter(eval(parse(text=outphase_condition))) %>%
	ggplot(aes(x = IPI, y = Asynchrony, color = factor(Participant))) +
	geom_point(alpha = 0.2) +
	geom_line(aes(group = interaction(Participant, Trial))) +
	facet_wrap(Effector~ISI) +
	scale_color_viridis_d(begin=color_begin, end=color_end,
						  option=color_palette) +
	scale_fill_viridis_d(begin=color_begin, end=color_end,
						 option=color_palette) +
	theme_bw(base_size=fsize) +
	theme(legend.position = "top",
		strip.background = element_blank())
# uncomment to show plot
# plot_outphase

# detect out-of-phase trials
df_times_outphase <- df_times %>% 
	group_by(Participant, Cond, Trial) %>%
	mutate(nTaps = n(),
		m_asyn = mean(Asynchrony)) %>%
	# detect out-of-phase taps
	filter(eval(parse(text=outphase_condition))) %>%
	group_by(Participant, Cond, Trial, ISI) %>%
	summarise(count_outphase = n(),
			nTaps = first(nTaps),
			m_asyn = first(m_asyn),
			outphase_fraction = count_outphase/nTaps) %>%
	# detect trials with a large fraction of out-of-phase taps
	filter(outphase_fraction > outphase_fraction_max) %>%
	arrange(desc(count_outphase))
# remove out-of-phase trials
df_times_inphase <- df_times %>%
	anti_join(df_times_outphase, by = c("Participant", "Cond", "Trial"))
df_voltages_inphase <- df_voltages %>%
	anti_join(df_times_outphase, by = c("Participant", "Cond", "Trial"))


```


## Outliers
```{r outliers, echo=FALSE}

# detect and remove random outliers (Tukey's fences)
df_times_outliers <- df_times_inphase %>%
	group_by(Participant, Cond) %>%
	mutate(Q1 = quantile(Asynchrony, 0.25),
			Q3 = quantile(Asynchrony, 0.75),
			lower_bound = Q1 - 1.5*(Q3-Q1),
			upper_bound = Q3 + 1.5*(Q3-Q1)) %>%
	filter(Asynchrony < lower_bound | Asynchrony > upper_bound) %>%
	select(-Q1, -Q3, -lower_bound, -upper_bound) %>%
	ungroup()
df_times_inphase <- df_times_inphase %>%
			anti_join(df_times_outliers,
					  by = c("Participant","Block","Cond","Trial","Tap"))
df_voltages_inphase <- df_voltages_inphase %>%
			anti_join(df_times_outliers,
					  by = c("Participant","Block","Cond","Trial","Tap"))

# detect and remove extremely short trials
df_times_inphase_participant <- df_times_inphase %>%
	group_by(Participant,Trial,Cond) %>%
	summarise(n_taps = n()) %>%
	filter(n_taps <= 2)
df_times_inphase <- df_times_inphase %>%
			anti_join(df_times_inphase_participant,
					  by = c("Participant", "Cond", "Trial"))
df_voltages_inphase <- df_voltages_inphase %>%
			anti_join(df_times_inphase_participant,
					  by = c("Participant", "Cond", "Trial"))

# outlier summary
print(paste0('number of initial valid taps: ',nrow(df_times)))
print(paste0('number of valid trials flagged as antiphase: '
					,nrow(df_times_outphase)))
print(paste0('number of valid taps after antiphase and random outlier removal: '
					,nrow(df_times_inphase)))


```

## Full model
```{r full_model, echo=FALSE}

# scaling covariate for convergence:
# instead of doing "df_times_inphase$IPI <- scale(df_times_inphase$IPI)"
# use lmerControl "autoscale" to automatically transform back to original scale

model_full <- lmer(data = df_times_inphase,
				Asynchrony ~ IPI*ISI*Feedback
							+ (1+IPI|Participant),
				control = lmerControl(autoscale = TRUE,
								optimizer="nloptwrap",
								check.conv.grad = .makeCC("warning",
														  tol = 0.01)))

# stricter tolerances for convergence
strict_tol <- lmerControl(optCtrl=list(xtol_abs=1e-10, ftol_abs=1e-10),
						  			check.conv.grad = .makeCC("warning",
						  									  tol = 0.001))
# start from a slightly perturbed previous optimum
previous_theta <- getME(model_full, "theta")*1.01
model_full <- update(model_full, control=strict_tol,
							start = list(theta = previous_theta))

print(model_full)
anova(model_full)
print("(nonsignificant effect of interpeak interval IPI)")


# # add individual predictions for plotting
# df_times_inphase <- df_times_inphase %>%
# 	add_predictions(model_full)


# contrasts
model_full_emtrends <- emtrends(model_full, pairwise~ISI:Feedback,
						var="IPI",
						infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
						lmer.df = "satterthwaite",
						lmerTest.limit = 10000)

test_slopes_minus1 <- test(model_full_emtrends$emtrends,
					null = -1, adjust = "bonferroni")
test_slopes_minus1
print("(slopes are significantly different from -1 after Bonferroni multiple comparisons correction)")

test_slopes_zero <- test(model_full_emtrends$emtrends,
					null = 0, adjust = "bonferroni")
test_slopes_zero
print("(slopes are not significantly different from 0 after Bonferroni multiple comparisons correction)")

model_full_emtrends$contrasts
print("(slopes are not significantly different from each other after Tukey multiple comparisons correction)")


# # check regression assumptions
# # uncommment to show

# plot_checkmodel


```
